p: the generations of Esau: This genealogy declares that Esau was blessed physically and that his father's blessing took place in worldly things.
daughters of Canaan: Besides those wives spoken of in Ge 26:34.
went into the country from the: In this, God's providence appears, which causes the wicked to give place to the godly, that Jacob might enjoy Canaan according to God's promise.
dukes of the sons of Esau: If God's promises are so sure towards those who are not of his household, how much more will he perform the same for us?
inhabited the land: Esau lived there before that.
mules in the wilderness: Who not contented with those kinds of beasts, which God had created, discovered the monstrous generation of mules between the ass and the mare.
kings that reigned in the land: The wicked rise up suddenly to honour and perish as quickly: but the inheritance of the children of God continues forever, Ps 102:28.
Rehoboth by the river reigned in: Which is by the river Euphrates.
Edomites: Of Edom came the Idumeans.
